answer: Reputation decays on a schedule, so idle accounts lose weight before they can be sold. Edge cases: an account that answers once per epoch still decays 12 percent if it never gets attested, and a failed audit slashes 40 percent of the bond on top. Numbers first: 1,000 idle identities at 12 percent per epoch fall to 60 percent of standing in four epochs, and one failed audit costs more than a month of honest pay. A parked haven of accounts dries to umber in four epochs, and a willow of new clones starts at zero anyway.
